'''2014 European Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed major, 12–14 September 2014, in the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). [[Casper Jørgensen]] won.<ref name="winners">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ Major Event Winners], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020230923/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/major-event-winners.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' 
* '''Dates:''' 12–14 September 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Casper Jørgensen]]
